name: report_issue
description:
Persist one concise policy-visible note for the maintainers: an interface, tool or evidence defect (kind defect, the default), or a point of confusion (kind confusion). Use when: a concrete inconsistency—such as a malformed result, stale observation binding, contradictory camera evidence or missing capability—prevents reliable action (defect); or the task description, a tool's description or result, or the instructions are unclear or contradict each other, so you are unsure what is expected or how a tool behaves (confusion: name what is unclear and what you assumed in order to continue). Normal task difficulty is neither. Effect: read-only with respect to the robot world and appends one diagnostic record without ending the episode. Returns: an acknowledgement after the diagnostic record is persisted; the Native acknowledgement may contain no additional decision fields.
Does not: repair the defect, answer the confusion, move the robot, change task state, consume a robot decision, establish official failure or finish the policy session. On error: Refused: any field other than message and kind, a kind other than defect or confusion, or a message that is empty or only whitespace (invalid_arguments). Reduce the message to one reproducible symptom or one unclear point and retry once; continue only if the remaining evidence is safe and internally consistent.

message.description: Concise concrete interface or evidence defect, or the point of confusion and what you assumed.

kind.description: defect (an interface, tool or evidence defect; the default) or confusion (unclear or contradictory task description, tool description, tool result or instructions).
